search_text: published ZDI-18-112 ZDI-CAN-5234 Trend Micro Control Manager CCGIServlet ID_QUERY_COMMAND_TRACKING_USER_ID SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2018-01-10 CVE-2018-3603 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2018-3603 6.5 ['Trend Micro'] ['Control Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within processing of the ID_QUERY_COMMAND_TRACKING_USER_ID parameter of the CCGIServlet servlet . The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the Network Service account. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
